observations.detail: TrackWhale's XRP exchange-flow page reports seven-day total outflows of 466.81M XRP ($589.79M) and inflows of 210.95M XRP ($262.62M). Its Binance row reports 340.12M XRP outflow and 199.95M XRP inflow.

TrackWhale's Binance page reports 30-day XRP asset outflow of $215.3M, while its seven-day XRP exchange-flow page reports Binance outflow of $431.78M. The pages do not establish that these values share the same inclusion universe.

A seven-day Binance XRP outflow of $431.78M is larger than the same provider's displayed 30-day XRP asset outflow of $215.3M. If both are cumulative measurements of the same transfer universe, the subset relationship is violated. The discrepancy indicates differing scope, coverage, valuation or a provider error; the public pages do not explain which.

Binance reports 233,461,943.1 XRP transferred from five hot wallets during the October 29 incident. XRPLWin valued it at approximately $296M at transfer time. TrackWhale's displayed 30-day XRP asset outflow is only $215.3M. This is evidence against assuming the incident is included in that asset-mix measure, but it does not establish whether the separate seven-day XRP flow page includes it.

relationship_graph.relation: same provider, different time windows and displayed XRP outflow totals that are not subset-consistent

competing_hypotheses.claim: The seven-day XRP exchange-flow page and the 30-day Binance asset-mix page use different inclusion rules, wallet coverage or valuation logic.
support: The seven-day Binance XRP outflow is larger than the displayed 30-day XRP asset outflow.
disconfirming_or_missing: TrackWhale has not published a field-level definition proving the exact source of the difference.
tests: Obtain transaction-level records and metric definitions for both pages.
Compare address registry versions and valuation timestamps.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The Binance October 29 incident transfer is not included in the 30-day XRP asset-mix value or is excluded by its asset-flow methodology.
support: The approximate transfer-time value of the 233.46M XRP incident transfer exceeds the displayed 30-day XRP asset outflow.
disconfirming_or_missing: The displayed asset-mix amount may be a partial bucket or use an undocumented valuation/inclusion rule.
tests: Match the five incident transaction hashes against provider records.
Check whether the provider labels the receiving account and source hot wallets.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The separate seven-day XRP exchange-flow page may include some or all of the Binance incident payments.
support: The incident occurred within the seven-day window and the page reports Binance external outflows.
disconfirming_or_missing: No transaction hashes or address-level membership are visible in the public page.
The 30-day cross-view discrepancy makes simple inclusion assumptions unsafe.
tests: Retrieve the 13 tracked outflow transactions and match ledger hashes.
Recompute totals after explicitly removing confirmed incident transfers.

competing_hypotheses.claim: TrackWhale's current aggregate XRP exchange-flow metrics should be excluded from organic flow features until the cross-view discrepancy is explained.
support: The seven-day and 30-day pages are not subset-consistent on their displayed XRP outflow values.
Transaction-level membership is unavailable in the public preview.
disconfirming_or_missing: A documented scope difference could reconcile the figures without an underlying calculation error.
tests: Require documented metric scope, point-in-time wallet registry and transaction-level reconciliation before restoring model eligibility.

data_quality.no_averaging_policy: Do not average TrackWhale's seven-day XRP flow and 30-day Binance asset-mix values; they are not demonstrated to be comparable.
data_quality.correction_to_prior_conditional_calculat: The prior conditional 50.0% gross-outflow and 91.2% net-outflow arithmetic must not be used as an estimate of actual incident contribution. It assumed compatible aggregate scope and possible inclusion without transaction-level proof. New cross-view evidence shows TrackWhale's displayed seven-day and 30-day XRP outflow values are not subset-consistent.
data_quality.quarantine_rule: Exclude both TrackWhale aggregate pages from model-facing organic XRP exchange-flow features until the provider's cross-view scope and transaction-hash membership are reconciled.

predictions.reason: The current provider's XRP exchange-flow aggregates fail cross-view consistency checks; no directional forecast is justified.

blockers: TrackWhale does not expose all transaction hashes behind the public aggregate preview.
The provider's seven-day XRP flow and 30-day Binance asset-mix values are not subset-consistent.
The Binance incident transfer's inclusion in either provider aggregate is unverified.
next_actions: Quarantine TrackWhale exchange-flow aggregates from the historical feature store.
Obtain transaction-level hashes and point-in-time wallet registry versions for both TrackWhale views.
Match the five Binance incident transfers against the seven-day and 30-day datasets.
Use XRPL raw ledger records and independent exchange-label sources for a separate reconstruction.
Restore TrackWhale features only after documented scope reconciliation and deterministic cross-window tests.
